title: FAI MCP Attachments v1
description: Validates the `mcpAttachments` field on `.agent.md` frontmatter. Declares which federated MCP areas an agent depends on. Read by the FrootAI engine and VS Code extension to pre-attach areas before the agent runs.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [M0.3] of the FAI MCP Federation Kernel masterplan. JSON Schema 2020-12 (matches `fai-manifest.v2.json`). Doctrine principle 8 — NO FORWARD-INCOMPATIBLE SCHEMA: any breaking change bumps the major version + ships a migration helper.

areas.description: Federated MCP area slugs this agent REQUIRES. Engine pre-flight validator fails the run if any area is unavailable (no trust override + no install).

optional.description: Federated MCP area slugs this agent CAN USE if available, but does NOT require. Engine attaches if pre-attached; never blocks if missing.
